name: Deadwood Ritual Totem
label: Quest
description: Deadwood Ritual Totem: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have found one of the Deadwood furbolg's ritual totems. The totem itself is of non-descript construction, but a palpable sense of despair emanates from it. If there were any object that might best exemplify the corruption that the Deadwood furbolg suffer under, this item would clearly be it.
One of the furbolgs inside Timbermaw Hold may have a use for such an item... That is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes adventurer, what can I assist you with? You walk among us peacefully, though there is assuredly something amiss. I sense something... Something troubling...

clips.title: Completion
paras: This totem... I recognize it as one of the Deadwood's, but it is thick with the stench of decay. Whatever foulness has turned our brethren against us is surely present in this object.

You were wise to bring this to us, friend. Perhaps through study and ritual, we can uncover what it is that pollutes the minds of our brethren. Thank you, friend - please accept these offerings in exchange for your find.
